methodologyNotes: Prices collected by fetching official vendor pricing pages directly. Where official pages returned 404/503/JS-only placeholders, reputable gaming-news aggregators (Wikipedia, Kotaku, Destructoid) were used as fallback and noted in each vendor's provenance. USD prices only; non-USD-confirmed figures are set to null. annualDiscountPct calculated where both monthly and annual prices are published. minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall are null on all plans (non-telephony vertical). accessedAt: 2026-06-14.

vendors.name: PlayStation Plus
vendors.provenance: Primary: official page https://www.playstation.com/en-us/ps-plus/ fetched 2026-06-14 — returned full USD pricing. Corroboration: PlayStation Plus Wikipedia article confirmed tier structure.

plans.name: Essential — 1 Month
plans.notes: Includes online multiplayer, 2–3 monthly free games, exclusive discounts, 100 GB cloud storage.

plans.name: Essential — 3 Months
plans.notes: Billed as $27.99 per 3 months ($9.33/mo effective). Same features as Essential 1-month.

plans.name: Essential — 12 Months
plans.notes: Billed as $79.99/yr ($6.67/mo effective). Month-to-month rate is $10.99/mo. Discount ~39% vs monthly.

plans.name: Extra — 1 Month
plans.notes: Adds Game Catalog (hundreds of PS4/PS5 titles) and Ubisoft+ Classics on top of Essential benefits.

plans.name: Extra — 3 Months
plans.notes: Billed as $43.99 per 3 months ($14.67/mo effective).

plans.name: Extra — 12 Months
plans.notes: Billed as $134.99/yr ($11.25/mo effective). Month-to-month rate is $16.99/mo. Discount ~34% vs monthly.

plans.name: Premium — 1 Month
plans.notes: Adds Classics Catalog (PS1/PS2/PSP titles), game trials, cloud streaming, and Sony Pictures Catalog on top of Extra.

plans.name: Premium — 3 Months
plans.notes: Billed as $54.99 per 3 months ($18.33/mo effective).

plans.name: Premium — 12 Months
plans.notes: Billed as $159.99/yr ($13.33/mo effective). Month-to-month rate is $19.99/mo. Discount ~33% vs monthly.

vendors.name: Xbox Game Pass
vendors.provenance: Official page https://www.xbox.com/en-US/xbox-game-pass rendered USD prices as '$XX.XX' placeholders (JS-rendered, geo-varies). Fell back to: (1) Destructoid article (published Oct 1, 2025) for Essential $9.99, Premium $14.99, Ultimate $29.99; (2) Kotaku tag page confirmed April 21, 2026 reduction of Ultimate from $30 to $23; (3) Wikipedia Xbox Game Pass article confirmed PC Game Pass at $13.99 (current, post-April-2026 reduction) and noted the April 2026 reduction applied to both Ultimate and PC Game Pass.

plans.name: Essential
plans.notes: Console-focused tier. 50+ games on console and supported devices, unlimited cloud gaming, online multiplayer. Introduced Oct 1, 2025 (renamed from Core). No day-one titles. First month $1 promotional offer. No April 2026 price change confirmed for this tier.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: 200+ games. New Xbox-published titles within 1 year of launch (not day-one). Cloud gaming with shorter wait times. Introduced Oct 1, 2025 (renamed from Standard). First 14 days $1 promotional offer. No April 2026 price change confirmed for this tier.

plans.name: Ultimate
plans.notes: 500+ games, day-one releases (excluding Call of Duty at launch as of April 21, 2026), includes EA Play and Ubisoft+ Classics. Raised to $29.99 on Oct 1, 2025; reduced to $22.99/mo on April 21, 2026 when day-one Call of Duty access was removed. VERIFIER 2026-06-14: corrected from $23.00 — official Xbox Wire announcement states exactly $22.99.

plans.name: PC Game Pass
plans.notes: 300+ PC games, day-one PC titles (excluding Call of Duty at launch as of April 21, 2026), includes EA Play on PC. Reduced from $16.49 to $13.99/mo on April 21, 2026 alongside the Ultimate reduction, per the official Xbox Wire announcement.

vendors.name: Nintendo Switch Online
vendors.provenance: Primary: official page https://www.nintendo.com/us/switch/online/ fetched 2026-06-14 — returned all four annual plan prices. Nintendo's official page and Wikipedia both confirm only annual pricing is offered in the US (no monthly option published on official site). Monthly effective rate = annual price / 12.

plans.name: Individual — 12 Months
plans.notes: Billed as $19.99/yr ($1.67/mo effective). Annual-only; no monthly plan published on official US storefront. Includes online multiplayer, NES/SNES game library, cloud saves.

plans.name: Family — 12 Months
plans.notes: Billed as $34.99/yr ($2.92/mo effective). Up to 8 Nintendo Accounts. Annual-only. Same features as Individual plan.

plans.name: Individual + Expansion Pack — 12 Months
plans.notes: Billed as $49.99/yr ($4.17/mo effective). Adds N64, Game Boy, Game Boy Advance, Mega Drive/Genesis libraries plus DLC packs (e.g. Animal Crossing, Mario Kart 8 Deluxe Booster Course Pass). Annual-only.

plans.name: Family + Expansion Pack — 12 Months
plans.notes: Billed as $79.99/yr ($6.67/mo effective). Up to 8 Nintendo Accounts. Includes Expansion Pack content. Annual-only.

vendors.name: EA Play
vendors.provenance: Primary: official page https://www.ea.com/ea-play fetched 2026-06-14 — returned full USD pricing for EA Play and EA Play Pro. Corroboration: https://www.ea.com/en-us/ea-play also returned matching prices.

plans.name: EA Play — Monthly
plans.notes: Access to EA game vault (hundreds of titles), 10-hour trials of new EA releases, 10% off digital EA purchases. Console and PC.

plans.name: EA Play — Annual
plans.notes: Billed as $39.99/yr ($3.33/mo effective). Month-to-month rate is $5.99/mo. Discount ~44% vs monthly.

plans.name: EA Play Pro — Monthly
plans.notes: PC only. Day-one access to all new EA releases (premium editions), expanded vault, exclusive in-game content. Superset of EA Play.

plans.name: EA Play Pro — Annual
plans.notes: Billed as $119.99/yr ($10.00/mo effective). Month-to-month rate is $16.99/mo. Discount ~41% vs monthly. PC only.

vendors.name: Ubisoft+
vendors.provenance: Official US pricing pages (store.ubisoft.com/us/ubisoft-plus, store.ubisoft.com/us/ubisoft-plus-plans, ubisoft.com/en-us/subscription) all returned HTTP 404 or 410 as of 2026-06-14. The German Ubisoft store (store.ubisoft.com/us/ubisoft-plus-plans with geo-redirect) returned EUR prices only: Classics €7.99/mo, Premium €17.99/mo. No authoritative USD price could be confirmed from any reachable source. USD prices are set to null per methodology (null is better than a guess). Tier names and features confirmed via Xbox/PlayStation ecosystem documentation.

plans.name: Ubisoft+ Classics
plans.notes: Access to legacy/back-catalog Ubisoft titles. Included with PlayStation Plus Extra and Premium tiers. Official US pricing page unavailable (404/410) as of 2026-06-14; EUR price observed at €7.99/mo from German store redirect — USD amount unconfirmed.

plans.name: Ubisoft+ Premium (Multi Access)
plans.notes: Day-one access to new Ubisoft releases in premium editions, 100+ games, playable on PC, PlayStation, and Xbox. Official US pricing page unavailable (404/410) as of 2026-06-14; EUR price observed at €17.99/mo from German store redirect — USD amount unconfirmed.

vendors.name: Apple Arcade
vendors.provenance: Primary: official page https://www.apple.com/apple-arcade/ fetched 2026-06-14 — returned monthly and annual USD pricing. Corroboration: Wikipedia Apple Arcade article confirmed identical prices ($6.99/mo, $49.99/yr).

plans.name: Apple Arcade — Monthly
plans.notes: 200+ exclusive games across iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV. Family Sharing included (up to 5 additional family members at no extra cost). New device purchasers may receive a 3-month free trial.

plans.name: Apple Arcade — Annual
plans.notes: Billed as $49.99/yr ($4.17/mo effective). Month-to-month rate is $6.99/mo. Discount ~40% vs monthly. Same content as monthly plan.

vendors.name: NVIDIA GeForce NOW
vendors.provenance: Official NVIDIA pages (nvidia.com/en-us/geforce-now/plans/, nvidia.com/en-us/geforce-now/premium-memberships/) returned 404. Main nvidia.com/en-us/geforce-now/ page did not display prices (JS-only). Fell back to Wikipedia GeForce Now article which provided specific USD prices ($9.99/mo Performance, $19.99/mo Ultimate) confirmed across two fetches of the same article. Day Pass pricing also from Wikipedia.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 1-hour gaming sessions, ad-supported waiting periods, longest queue times, 1080p/60fps max. No cost but requires own game library.

plans.name: Performance — Monthly
plans.notes: 6-hour gaming sessions, priority queue, up to 1080p/60fps (renamed from Priority in Nov 2024). As of Jan 1, 2026: 100-hour/month playtime cap; additional 15-hour blocks available at $2.99 each.

plans.name: Performance — Annual
plans.notes: Billed as $99.99/yr ($8.33/mo effective). Month-to-month rate is $9.99/mo. Discount ~17% vs monthly.

plans.name: Ultimate — Monthly
plans.notes: 8-hour sessions, 4K/120fps, RTX 4080 server-class GPU, lowest queue times. As of Jan 1, 2026: 100-hour/month playtime cap; additional 15-hour blocks at $5.99 each.

plans.name: Ultimate — Annual
plans.notes: Billed as $199.99/yr ($16.67/mo effective). Month-to-month rate is $19.99/mo. Discount ~17% vs monthly.
